messages:
Alex C.: Heads-up — during last night's GPU node rollout in eu-west-1 we started seeing a ton of NLB target registration failures across AZs. services behind the NLB are 502ing briefly.

Mira L.: ugh. same clusters as the new dedicated GPU pools? any errors from the controller logs?

Alex C.: yep, the scaleup was for dedicated-gpu-{a,b,c}. Controller shows: `RegisterTargetsFailed: Target registration limit exceeded` from AWS. Happens when nodes join (kube-proxy/eni) and we try to register pod IPs as targets for the internal NLB.

Sam P.: do we know which quota exactly? is it target groups per NLB, targets per target group, or VPCE ENI / IP limits? AWS messaging is a bit ambiguous.

Alex C.: looks like targets-per-AZ-per-loadbalancer is the one hitting. From support logs: "Exceeded target registration limit in availability zone eu-west-1a". Default account limit is ~100 per AZ for this type (rough quote) and we pushed >300 during the burst.

Yejin K.: Can you paste the exact error snippet and the account id+region? I'll open a quota request with cloud-ops and AWS support.

Alex C.: error snippet:
```
ERROR: RegisterTargets failed for TargetGroup arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:123456789012:targetgroup/tg-ded-gpu/abcd1234
Cause: Target registration limit exceeded in availability zone eu-west-1a
```
Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-1
Requested bump: targets-per-AZ-per-NLB from 100 -> 800
Rationale: onboarding 8 new dedicated GPU clusters, each creates ~40 pod-targets per AZ under our internal NLBs; burst scale during deploys pushes us past current soft limits.

Mira L.: that sounds reasonable. For the request body we should mention mitigation plan and timeline. Also ask for NLB-targetgroup-count increase if needed.

Sam P.: temporary mitigation: we can stagger node rollouts by AZ and reduce kube-proxy target churn. But long term we need a quota increase or deploy the new clusters behind additional NLBs.

Yejin K.: I'll create the quota ticket. Draft note for cloud-ops/AWS support:
```
Hello,
Account 123456789012 in eu-west-1 is hitting the NLB target registration per-AZ limit during scale events. We request increase of "Targets per Availability Zone per Network Load Balancer" from 100 to 800 and "Target groups per load balancer" from 50 to 200. This supports 8 dedicated GPU clusters that register pod IPs as targets. We will stagger rollouts and implement connection draining to reduce churn.
Contact: Yejin K. (infra)
Estimated timeline: required immediately for upcoming capacity onboarding on 2026-04-01.
```
I'll attach controller logs and example ARNs.

infra-bot: New ticket created: CLOUD-7892 — "NLB target per-AZ quota increase (eu-west-1)". AWS case ID: 9876543210. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=9876543210

Alex C.: nice — can you add a request to increase private endpoint (VPCE) target limits too? We saw some VPCE attachment throttling when registering internal endpoints for autoscaled nodes.

Yejin K.: added a follow-up to the ticket asking VPCE target quota raise from 50 -> 500 and ENI quotas reviewed. Also asked for accelerated review citing production impact.

Mira L.: good. Meanwhile Sam, please implement the staggered rollout plan and a short-term webhook to hold registrations when failures spike.

Sam P.: on it. I'll open a small change to the autoscaler to add 30s jitter per-AZ and a circuit breaker that backs off NLB registrations after 5 failures.

Alex C.: thanks team. keep updates in this thread and paste the AWS support resolution here when it lands. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: AWS Support updated case 9876543210: "Request received — case under review." Timestamp: 1812345800

Yejin K.: AWS asked for the expected sustained and burst target counts — I responded with hourly + peak numbers. Will post reply once they confirm.

Sam P.: deployed stagger + backoff to staging, looks good. Will roll to prod tonight during maintenance window 22:00 UTC.

Alex C.: copy. last ask — add the new quota numbers to our runbook and make the quota values part of the cluster provisioning check so we don't hit this unexpectedly in other regions.

Mira L.: noted. I'll update runbook and add a preflight check to the cluster-ops pipeline.

Yejin K.: CASE RESOLVED by AWS: Increased targets-per-AZ-per-NLB to 1000 and VPCE target quota to 600 for account 123456789012 in eu-west-1. Closing ticket. (timestamp 1812345890)

Alex C.: excellent, thanks everyone. Closing the loop — postmortem + runbook updates incoming.
